Saved metrics reproduce at 1.0 on 50 held-out packet-table rows, but the split is not session-independent: train and validation share processing run 20261005T155313Z, and the test is one other processing run. Fourteen single features, a depth-1 tree, and every tested feature/group ablation score 1.0. IDs/filenames encode labels; no source-session IDs, per-record raw PCAPs, or independent ground-truth sidecars are available. Candidate remains inference-blocked.

Reproduced the candidate from its saved model and source-derived vista-flow-v1 features; recomputed report metrics from saved predictions. Evaluated majority and depth-1 tree baselines, packet-count-only and single-feature baselines, every individual-feature removal and predefined feature-group removals. Diagnostic report establishes recipe shortcuts, not generalization.

No verified capture-session IDs exist in the source records. The current train/validation partition shares one processing run; the held-out data represents only one other processing run. Source directories contain packet-table CSVs but no per-observation raw PCAP or independent endpoint ground-truth records.

Versioned v1/v2 manifest preparation validates explicit ground-truth sources, raw PCAP and measurement/SA hashes, outer-ESP packet extraction, duplicate quarantine, feature/label separation, and deterministic session-level splits. In Phase 5 campaign e2e8adae-94d7-4a1d-9569-3c3e1a965e64, 15 independent sessions (30 observations) were admitted with zero quarantines and a clean 9/3/3 session split without leakage (READY_FOR_REVIEW).

Automated audit of campaign e2e8adae-94d7-4a1d-9569-3c3e1a965e64 verified 15 distinct session UUIDs, 30 unique experiment UUIDs, 15 distinct verified IKE_SA identities, zero hash discrepancies across all artifacts, outer ESP packets in all 30 PCAPs, sender/receiver agreement on ICMP and TCP, and zero session/key leakage across 9/3/3 split.

In Phase 5, capture reliability was hardened (tcpdump --immediate-mode, priming grace barrier, continuous SIGUSR1 packet-dispatch confirmation, container sync before copy, and failure diagnostics). The intermittent 24-byte empty PCAP was isolated to TPACKET_V3 packet buffering and socket attachment race, and resolved. A reproducible campaign runner executed 15 independent sessions with verified IKE_SA terminate-and-reinit lifecycles and varied ICMP/TCP profiles across payload sizes 32-1400 bytes, counts 3-10, and intervals 0.2-0.8s (campaign e2e8adae-94d7-4a1d-9569-3c3e1a965e64). Workload coverage is strictly limited to controlled benign ICMPv4 echo and TCP marker outer-ESP metadata; RTP-like, HTTP/HTTPS, SMTP, WhatsApp-like, video, IPv6, and attack traffic remain unverified and blocked. No models were trained, promoted, or deployed.

In Phase 6, implemented real bounded HTTP/1.1 client/server exchange over IPsec tunnel using container-native Perl in PC1 and PC2. Validates outer ESP on PC1 eth0, server evidence on PC2, status 200 OK, response bytes, and content SHA-256 match. Live test executed with 3/3 matching requests, 33 outer ESP packets, and 0 hash discrepancies (Session 15298fa7-7e97-44b0-8e7c-fac238db54e0, Experiment 60883e93-7174-405f-8f9d-cdf06d2e6894).

Automated audit of HTTP experiment 15298fa7-7e97-44b0-8e7c-fac238db54e0 / 60883e93-7174-405f-8f9d-cdf06d2e6894 verified all 11 artifact files present, 100% SHA-256 hash match against manifest, 33 outer ESP packets on PC1, 18 TCP packets on PC2, client/server agreement on 3 requests (200 OK, 68 response bytes, exact response-body SHA-256 match), and CHILD_SA counter delta +15 in / +18 out packets.

Automated audit of campaign 9bd6b15c-507d-451a-89eb-7071944f105f verified 15 distinct session UUIDs, 30 unique experiment UUIDs (15 GET, 15 POST), 15 distinct verified IKE_SA identities, zero hash discrepancies across all artifacts, outer ESP frames in all 30 PCAPs, client/server agreement on status 200 OK, byte counts, and body digests, and a leakage-free 9/3/3 session split without session or IKE SPI key overlap (READY_FOR_REVIEW).

Corrected batch extractor matches all 18 ordered runtime vista-flow-v1 features on an IPv4 PCAP fixture: durations/rates, population standard deviations, timestamp-derived IAT, canonical directions, directional byte sums, and rounding. This is feature-contract parity only; IPv6 and protocol eligibility are not established.
